name: CLX - Admin LUXI Restream Channels v1

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: DEACTIVATED. Admin-gated. Reads the operator's Restream account and returns {watch_urls, rtmp_ingest_url, stream_key} so Go Live can auto-fill instead of the operator pasting five links by hand. Read-only: changes nothing in Restream.

nodes.name: Fetch Channels
nodes.notes: OAuth2. Each channel carries url (the public watch link), streamingPlatformId and active.

nodes.name: Fetch Platforms
nodes.notes: Public, no auth. Maps streamingPlatformId -> platform name. Fetched live rather than hardcoded so a new platform id does not silently break the mapping.

nodes.name: Fetch Stream Key
nodes.notes: OAuth2. The operator's RTMP stream key.

nodes.name: Fetch Servers
nodes.notes: Public, no auth. Ingest servers; we take Autodetect (rtmp://live.restream.io/live).
